context: Tests the remaining #57 prose-catalog work: ceremonial coverage versus actual source evidence, connected-to relationship judgment, current versus historical vocabulary weighting, identity/genre-calibrated em-dash observations, and valid Markdown boundaries.

checklist.name: Ceremonial coverage flagged
checklist.description: The independent-coverage/featured-in/trade-publications sentence is identified as ceremonial proof and removed or rewritten around evidence rather than publication status.

checklist.name: Used publication evidence retained
checklist.description: The Wired and InfoQ measurement sentence is retained in substance and is not flagged merely for naming publications; the report explains that it uses what the sources established.

checklist.name: Vague relationships resolved
checklist.description: The connected-to rollout and associated-with retry-queue claims are flagged as hiding concrete roles and are rewritten from available evidence or marked for verification rather than guessed.

checklist.name: Literal technical connection retained
checklist.description: The client connected to Postgres over TLS remains unchanged in substance and is explicitly treated as precise domain language, not pattern #40.

checklist.name: Em dashes calibrated
checklist.description: The report uses the same-mode passages and rhetorical function to judge the em-dash observations, does not invoke a two-per-section hard threshold, and preserves the draft's earned aside or gives a specific evidence-backed reason to change it.

checklist.name: Current vocabulary cluster fixed
checklist.description: The showcasing/emphasizing/seamless promotional cluster is flagged and rewritten around facts.

checklist.name: Precise highlight usage retained
checklist.description: The trace-highlights sentence is retained or changed only for a concrete prose reason; one precise use is not treated as contamination.

checklist.name: Historical term weighted weakly
checklist.description: The single use of delve is recognized as a historical, weak standalone signal; any rewrite is for plainness and not presented as proof of AI authorship.

checklist.name: Markdown constructs preserved
checklist.description: The H1, H2 headings, list, repeated title metadata, and useful comparison table remain valid constructs and are not flagged as AI prose.

checklist.name: Accuracy stays separate
checklist.description: The report keeps source correctness and link health in an accuracy or source-verification category instead of treating them as style tells.
